data.command: Can you tell me about your firewall rules?

data.text:
You want to know about our firewall rules, eh?

So, we're running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, with the Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) enabled. By default, UFW blocks all incoming and outgoing traffic, but we've configured it to allow specific services to run.

Here's a quick rundown of our current firewall rules:

```bash
sudo ufw status
```

Output:
```
Status: active

To                         Action      From
--                         -----      ----
OpenSSH                    ALLOW       192.168.0.0/16
OpenSSH (v6)               ALLOW       192.168.0.0/16
http                       ALLOW       Anywhere
https                      ALLOW       Anywhere
OpenSSH on eth0             ALLOW       Anywhere
```

We've allowed incoming traffic on port 22 (SSH) for our internal network (192.168.0.0/16), as well as on ports 80 (http) and 443 (https) for our web server. These rules are applied to the default (already configured) rules, so we don't have to worry about accidentally blocking something.
